statusLegend.verified: Recovered as plaintext and asserted by tests.
statusLegend.mapped: Recovered and represented in the Cocos data model.
statusLegend.fallback: Current Cocos implementation remains authoritative until parity is proven.
statusLegend.unverified: Not present as reliable plaintext; no value was invented.

numericValues.details: 26 decrypted bank snapshots are packaged; regular banks preserve rank 1-5 counts and technique counters.

levelDesign.details: 685 normalized classic records are available under assets/resources/apk-1.8.1/levels; 4x4, 5x5, and 11x11 keep fallback coverage where the regular APK bank is incomplete.

economy.details: Exact APK streak, reward, interstitial unlock, cooldown, revive, banner unlock, and normal ad reward values are loaded from runtime-data.json at bootstrap; the Cocos paw-token supplement is not used for the APK check-in reward.

aiAndPathfinding.details: The APK is a constraint puzzle and exposes no plaintext pathfinding system. The current Cocos RuleEngine/Solver remains active; imported levels retain APK rank and r1-r5 technique data.

algorithmsAndRollback.details: Dual save slots, versioned endgame snapshot fields, serialized step history, and APK rule data are preserved in runtime-data.json; Cocos save migration remains the compatibility layer.

retention.details: Seven-day streak, active/session timers, GRT level milestones, level windows, and time windows are loaded into the active retention plan as apkGuidance.

networkProtocolAndDataStructures.details: Only the debug HTTP API is plaintext and recorded. Production endpoints and wire schemas are not guessed or enabled.

resourceManagementAndLoading.details: Decrypted banks are packaged as Cocos resources; runtime loads runtime-data.json, prefers the normalized APK catalog, and falls back to the existing catalog for missing IDs.
